<!-- pr-reviewer: 95ab4115269af5e9ae375b6c5072eb762098117e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thank you for this fix. The change is small and correct.

### What looks good

- The change is in one file: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer_ride.rs`. Only the refusal text of `ride_loops` and its doc comment change. The refusal condition, the geometry and the API do not change.
- The new text "would ride into the material under it" fits a part source and a stock source. Issue #2521 permits this option.
- The pinning test `a_wall_farther_than_the_width_refuses_by_name` now asserts the new text. It also asserts that the text does not contain `part`.
- No other test, doc or skill quotes the old text. `git grep "ride into"` finds only `RECOMMENDED.md` history and this file.
- No posted G-code, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation or geometry changes. No UI change, no golden, no snapshot PNG, no process file, no dependency.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2521`. The commit subject is conventional.

### Results, merged with main (locally)

The PR head was trial-merged with `upstream/main` (no conflicts). All runs were local, on Linux.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: motion lib | ok: 434 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored |
| `cargo xtask gate quick`: app `chamfer_modelled_edge` | ok: 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Mutations (local only, then reverted):

1. Put the old text "would ride into the part;" back. The pinning test fails at `chamfer_ride.rs:139` (red, as expected).
2. Keep the new text, but add "part" in another position ("pick the part edges to break"). The pinning test fails at `chamfer_ride.rs:140` (red, as expected).

After the revert, the 4 `chamfer_ride` tests pass.

### Requested before merge

None.

### Notes (not blocking)

- AGENTS.md says that the PR body ends with `Fixes #N`. Here, a "Generated with Claude Code" line follows it. GitHub still closes the issue. You can move the footer above the `Fixes` line in future PRs.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
